# Ca-perovskite: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/ca_perovskite.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/ca_perovskite.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/ca_perovskite.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- The source does not state weights, fitting software, covariance, or the confidence convention for its printed errors. Unweighted pressure residuals are a transparent reproducibility diagnostic; their recovery of both coefficients and error magnitudes for all four source models is strong evidence for, but not proof of, the authors' exact numerical objective.

- **Fixed parameters:** Tr; n

## Joint Sun (2016) + Gréaux (2019) data, cubic CaSiO3 BM3-MGD (Fu 2023)

**disagrees** · `ca_perovskite_fu_2023_bm3_mgd_refit` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/ca_perovskite.md#record-ca_perovskite_fu_2023_bm3_mgd_refit)

**Warning:** Not recommended for quantitative use. Explicit selection only; not loaded by default.

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The complete candidate observation rows were recovered from the author-hosted Sun PDF and official Gréaux XLSX and are now bundled as attributed numerical transcriptions. Fu et al. publish neither an objective, row/output weights, covariance, nor code. Four explicit weighting diagnostics, including propagated P-V uncertainty, all converge away from Table S3, especially for gamma0 and q; this is therefore a completed non-parity audit, not an exact reconstruction of an undisclosed fit protocol. Kawai-Tsuchiya and Li curves are analytical comparisons, while Thomson is explicitly excluded. Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published thermal parameterization retains an unresolved high-temperature discrepancy against the reconstructed source observations; source normalization checks do not reconcile it.

**Source review:** `not_reproduced`.

- Not recommended for scientific predictions or pressure calibration. Retained only for explicit diagnostic inspection. The published thermal parameterization retains an unresolved high-temperature discrepancy against the reconstructed source observations; source normalization checks do not reconcile it.
